requirement: Design system preview assets: stylesheets of a demo on another host read at its public address

oracle.ref: PR #1360 (fix); fix evidence: 14/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site after PR #1356: every preview-asset request of the 24 Joomla demos on fleet01 answered 502 DEMO_UNREADABLE and the Add site preview showed an unstyled page; the same CSS at the demo's public address answered 200
oracle.invariant: S1: 200 text/css with the file's bytes, only the public address fetched. S2: 200 read on its container only; 400 for a picture, a page or an escape, 404 for an unknown demo, nothing fetched for them.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
